article.intro: A good dinosaur name is built from Greek and Latin word parts that describe the animal: Velociraptor means "swift thief" and Triceratops "three-horned face". The **Dinosaur Name Generator** makes up new dinosaurs the same way and tells you what each name means. Pick realistic, fantasy or funny, or make a dinosaur from your own first name.

sections.heading: Eight good dinosaur names
sections.content:
All eight came from the generator, two from each kind:

  • Nyctovenator: "night hunter", a predator that comes out after dark.
  • Macronychus: "long claw", short and believable, like a real genus.
  • Titanodrakon: "titan dragon", for a fantasy world where dragons and dinosaurs meet.
  • Sapphirodrakon custos: a jewel-coloured dragon with a Latin species name meaning "guardian".
  • Biscuitodon: "biscuit-toothed", a funny name built the proper way.
  • Hiccup Rex: "the hiccup king", a joke on Tyrannosaurus rex.
  • Samosuchus viridis: "Sam's green crocodile", made from a first name.
  • Priyaraptor tonans: Priya's thundering thief.

sections.heading: How dinosaurs get their names
sections.content:
The word dinosaur was coined by the anatomist Richard Owen in 1842, from the Greek deinos, "terrible", and sauros, "lizard". Every dinosaur since has been named from word parts like these, most of them Greek or Latin:

  • -saurus, lizard: Stegosaurus, the "roof lizard".
  • -raptor, thief, and -venator, hunter, for predators.
  • -onychus, claw: Deinonychus is the "terrible claw".
  • -mimus, mimic: Gallimimus, the "chicken mimic", was named for looking like a giant bird.
  • -tops, face, and -ceratops, horned face: Triceratops.
  • -titan, for the giants: Patagotitan, one of the biggest sauropods ever found, is the titan of Patagonia.

A full scientific name has two parts. The genus comes first, with a capital letter, and the species second, in lower case, both in italics: Tyrannosaurus rex, "tyrant lizard king". Species names often describe the animal or honour a person or place, and scientists can have a sense of humour. Masiakasaurus knopfleri is named after Mark Knopfler of Dire Straits, whose music was playing while the team dug it up.

One thing the generator never calls a dinosaur: a Pterodactyl. Pterosaurs flew alongside the dinosaurs but weren't dinosaurs themselves. Here -dactyl, "finger", is only used in the funny names.

sections.heading: Using your dinosaur
sections.content:
• Choose the format. With its meaning is best for a story or a school project, Full species sounds like a museum label, and Name only is quickest.
  • Make one from your name. Type a first name and choose From my name. It's a good way to get children interested in how scientific names work.
  • Draw it. The meaning tells you what to draw: a "frost-footed lizard" or a "rose-crested titan" practically designs itself.

Naming a dinosaur toy or a pet rather than a species? The Pet Dinosaur Name Generator has cute, funny and fierce names. For other pets, try the Black Cat and Christmas Pet name generators, and for other creatures, the Dragon and Monster name generators.

faqs.question: How do you make up a dinosaur name?
faqs.answer: Join Greek or Latin word parts that describe it: a feature (claw, crest, horn) plus an ending like -saurus (lizard), -raptor (thief) or -titan (giant). Nyctovenator, for example, is "night hunter". The generator does this for you and gives the meaning.

faqs.question: Can I make a dinosaur from my name?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose From my name and type your first name. Sam becomes Samosuchus viridis, Sam's green crocodile, or another species built on your name.

faqs.question: Are these real dinosaurs?
faqs.answer: No. They're made up in the way real dinosaurs are named, so they sound right, but you won't find them in a museum. A real name has to be published by scientists in a research paper.
